# CGMES test fixture

`pandapower_example_multivoltage.zip` is pandapower's `example_multivoltage`
network exported as CGMES 2.4.15, copied unchanged from the pandapower
repository (`test/test_files/example_cim/example_multivoltage.zip`).

used to check the import by hand are not included here.
